adapter_policy: The S-Story skeleton (user 2026-10-31) as a table module of the project database intermediary (qnc-db-broker): skeleton_elements and the view public_skeleton_elements. Each element is a source clip in order (statement ton or voice over off) with its IN/OUT, A1/A2 (camera channel, level, off), J/L of A1, the pause or cut before it and its origin in the script. It is its own record, apart from the script and the Story, and the safe copy a broken Story is sent again from. It owns only its table and is written only through the intermediary.
